description: RMS discrepancy between H and D Voigt profiles (H placed at the D position with identical column, temperature and turbulent width — only the isotope mass differs), relative to the instrumental noise level.
method: build_model_components M_Dfree with opt_D params vs M_H with H placed at D position (same N, T_K, b_turb); RMS of (flux_D - flux_H) / err
